title: French far-right activist killed: Can far-left recover from political fallout?
summary: Eleven people, including an aide to a French lawmaker with the far-left France Unbowed party, have been arrested on suspicion of involvement in the ​killing of ‌a far-right activist that has exposed deep political ⁠tensions in France ahead of elections. France 24's Marc Perelman takes a closer look at the political fallout.
